title: Midjourney Launches V8.2 Image Model: Sharper Aesthetics, Fewer Unwanted Shots, and Better Personalization to Understand Your Taste

content_html:
Midjourney has officially launched its V8.2 image model. This update focuses on two main aspects— aesthetics and image quality, as well as personalization.

In the official update announcement, the changes are broken down into several points. The images produced by the new model should be more creative, bolder, more refined, and have more sharpness and freshness, no longer being flat and unremarkable. The random situations that previously resulted in low-quality images have been significantly reduced. The personalization module will "understand" your personal aesthetic better—especially when you have a large number of rating records under your account, its ability to understand your preferences will improve significantly. When creating a personalized profile for V8.2, the available image pool has also been made larger and better.

The team specifically mentioned at the end: thank you for everyone's previous help in rating images, which made this update possible; and strongly recommend that you try both the old and new sets of personalized profiles with the latest model.

content_html_zh:
中途正式推出V8.2形象模型。 本次更新主要关注两个方面——美观、图像质量以及个性化。

在官方更新公告中，改动分为几个点。 新模型产生的图像应该更有创意、更大胆、更精致，并且更加锐利和新鲜，不再是平淡无奇的。 以前导致低质量图像的随机情况已显着减少。 个性化模块会更好地“理解”你的个人审美——尤其是当你的账户下有大量评分记录时，它理解你喜好的能力会显着提高。 在为V8.2创建个性化配置文件时，可用图像池也变得更大更好。

团队在最后特别提到：感谢大家之前对图片评分的帮助，使得本次更新成为可能；并强烈建议您尝试使用最新型号的新旧个性化配置文件集。
